eyebrow: Similar syntax, both backed by tempdb
caption: The real difference is statistics, not storage.

code:
#temp table
  real column statistics maintained
  accurate cardinality estimates

@table variable
  no statistics in most versions/settings
  optimizer falls back to a fixed,
  low-row-count estimate — regardless
  of actual row count
